简介: Margherita Spampinato was born in Palermo in 1979. She has been editing secretary on more than 30 films including Venuto al Mondo by Sergio Castellitto, Gli amici del bar Margherita by Pupi Avati and many other. For five years, he worked on casting for films and series such as Petra by Maria Sole Tognazzi and Suburra. La serie. As a director, he made two short films: Tommasina and Segreti.
